call_points.text: Underlying entity-level EBITDA margin for FY26 stood at 11% excluding one-off provisions and settlements.
The company received ₹343 Cr from BHEL under the settlement agreement during FY25-26, closing all related claims.
Core services order booking grew ~34% YoY compared to FY24-25.
Third party fleet (oOEM) order growth reached ~1.9x over FY24-25, scaling to ₹320 Cr.

penalties.impact: The financial impact of the Order is to the extent of the penalty levied. There is no impact on operations or other activities of the Company due to the Order

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Electrical Equipment > Heavy Electrical Equipment

operating_notes.text: GEPIL entered into leave and license and contract manufacturing agreements with Quality Profiles Private Limited for the Vadodara facility.
Core services third-party fleet orders grew to ₹320 Cr in FY26.
FY26 core services order intake grew 32% YoY.

Demerger of Durgapur facility manufacturing power boilers components, pressure vessels, piping, and coal mills to JSW Energy with a swap ratio of 10 shares of JSW Energy for every 139 shares of GE Power India.

timeline.summary: GE Power India board approved leave & license and contract manufacturing agreements with Quality Profiles on May 5, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹316.4 Cr, net profit ₹113.21 Cr.
GE Power India released its Q4 and FY26 earnings presentation highlighting a 34% growth in core services order intake.
GE Power India Limited’s Managing Director **Puneet Bhatla** shared the earnings call recording link on 12 May 2026 via **Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations Regulations, 2015**.
GE Power India reported FY26 revenue of ₹1,269 Cr and net profit of ₹252.61 Cr, recommending a 70% dividend.
On June 3, 2026, GE Power India announced receipt of the NCLT order directing meetings for the JSW Energy scheme of arrangement.
GE Power India received the NCLT Mumbai Bench sanction order for the demerger of its Durgapur undertaking to JSW Energy.

watchlist.text: Shareholder and NCLT approval for Durgapur demerger
Shareholder and creditor approval for the Scheme of Arrangement
